title: Mirror twins
notes: After the actual-frame pretest succeeds, a first visit may end with matching true copies and the repeated-label pair (K-1 P1-3). On return, K-1 can make repeated-label and restored-label pairs (P4-5). Grades 2-3 can compare fresh label merges and then restore distinct labels (P4-6). Grades 4-5 can choose the viewing-direction certificate (P3), the all-merge explanation (P4), or the rotation/class counts (P5-6) as separate investigations. Keep the model specification and orientation check from guide pp1-2; the pretest remains unperformed here.
